title: Schubert compactifications of matrix pencils
summary: The Schubert compactification of a linear space of matrices $L \subseteq \textrm{Mat}_{n\times m}$ is a natural compactification of $L$ in the Grassmannian $\textrm{Gr}(n, n+m)$. This construction generalises classical Schubert varieties and matroid Schubert varieties, and it turns invariants of linear matrix spaces into projective and intersection-theoretic invariants of the associated variety.
